facts.name: Derek A. Lewis
facts.assignment: Profile: county appointment2025; Marathon circuit criminal, county criminal, county civil, small claims, municipal and traffic matters.

contact.contact_note: Published office line; no personal judge email or separate assistant-only number identified.

scheduling.summary: File motion first, then request hearing by JA email with case/motion, requested time and coordination information. Coordinate parties; profile permits JA scheduling after three unsuccessful coordination attempts including a phone call. Promptly file/serve notice after reservation.

communications.summary: Email JA for procedural/scheduling matters with case number/name/matter in subject and copy all parties/counsel; no substantive ex parte messages. Notify JA and file/serve notice to cancel.

conferral.summary: County civil section states prefiling meet-and-confer for non-dispositive motions, attached certificate and at least one telephone attempt. Preserved as local page instruction, not independent interpretation of Rule1.202 exceptions.

proposed_orders.summary: Word format, shared with other parties, cover letter indicating agreement/disagreement; proposed-order e-filing channel linked to court notices. Ordinarily submit within two days after hearing unless instructed otherwise.

courtesy_copies.summary: PDF/A copies emailed to clerk or JA. Section B says hearing materials five business days before hearing; section E says courtesy copies five days. Units preserved without resolving.

remote_appearance.summary: Unless instructed otherwise, file remote-appearance motion for each hearing and obtain order; request five days ahead. Zoom2139257689; join fifteen minutes early. Hybrid description is not blanket permission.

ai_disclosure.summary: Section P states filings using AI must disclose use on the document and certify independent accuracy verification. Original certification language retained; relationship to statewide requirements not adjudicated.

noncivil_basic_operations.summary: Shared A–K office procedures apply; criminal and traffic standing-order/form links retained without substantive analysis.
